_how_to: Written by the in-game bg editor (--bgeditor --sandbox), R14-22. Each dx (world px, right positive) is ADDED to the mapdata path end: "ally_walk_end" moves Ash's right walk bound (human_path[-1].x — the R14-21 getFirst/LastPoint rule reads these ends), "enemy_spawn" moves the enemy entrance mouth (deadite_path right end + the spawn sx + walk-in targets stay on the rail). Vertical drags are ignored: walk/spawn y follows the path. Missing file/keys = the mapdata ends. Guide: work/tmp_final14/BG_EDITOR_HOWTO.md.
